newsitem.title: USA: Hi-Lo Auto sees continued improvement.
newsitem.headline: Hi-Lo Auto sees continued improvement.

text.p: Hi-Lo Automotive Inc said Thursday it expects improvement through the summer, after reporting a first quarter loss of $0.04 per share on sales of $55.5 million.
"Operating results improved from the fourth quarter of 1996, and we anticipate continued improvement throughout the summer selling season," a company statement said.
In January the company reported a fourth quarter loss of $0.17 a share on sales of $56 million.
For the 1996 first quarter, the company said it had a $0.04 per share loss on sales of $60 million.
